provenance.notes: MapLibre GL JS is a renderer: the terms are those of the style's source. This policy is OpenFreeMap's public instance (tiles.openfreemap.org, the default style): "no limits on the number of map views or requests", no key, no registration, no cookies, commercial use allowed (FAQ). Attribution is required: MapLibre shows the style's own; in other clients, print or video, "OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap" (the OpenFreeMap part optional). The terms of service allow offline downloads only of at most 3,000 tiles or 50 MB each, at most 4 parallel requests, with a unique User-Agent naming the application (larger ones: info@openfreemap.org), and forbid other automated data collection; caching by users is not addressed, nor redistribution. Best effort, may be discontinued without notice. The data is OpenStreetMap's (ODbL). With a style of another source (MapTiler, Mapbox, one's own), the provider declares an unknown policy instead: the site reads that source's terms and declares them (policy).
